notes: I replaced "uppercase first char + lowercase rest" with `str.capitalize()`. E10 shows the first character is *title*-cased, not upper-cased: ß→"Ss" (not "SS"), ﬁ→"Fi" (not "FI"), ǅ stays ǅ, Ǆ→ǅ, and ΣΟΦΟΣ→Σοφος keeps final ς. `capitalize()` reproduces all of E10 and also fixes E9's "ß sharp s"→"Sssharps".
